summary: Computes and stores a screen position under one of nine alignment modes. Stores a4 into the Z/size field at offset 0x10, then computes X (offset 0x8) and Y (offset 0xC) from the anchor (a2, a3) and the object's width (offset 0x14) and height (offset 0x18) according to the mode a5 (0-8) selected via the jump table at 0x004DCEBC, and finally renders through sub_4DCA80. Modes 0-5 anchor one corner exactly; modes 6-8 center vertically and/or horizontally.

operations.description: Store a4 into this[4], the Z/size field at offset 0x10, unconditionally at entry.
Dispatch on alignment mode a5 (0-8) through the jump table jpt_4DCDE4 at 0x004DCEBC; any value outside 0-8 falls through to the default path.
Compute the X anchor offset from a2: unshifted for modes 0,3,6; a2 - width (offset 0x14) for modes 1,4,7; a2 - width/2 for modes 2,5,8.
Write the computed X into this[2], the position field at offset 0x8.
Compute the Y anchor offset from a3: unshifted for modes 0,1,2; a3 - height (offset 0x18) for modes 3,4,5; a3 - height/2 for modes 6,7,8.
Write the computed Y into this[3], the position field at offset 0xC.
Call sub_4DCA80(this) to render the element using the stored position fields; executed on every path, including the default case that leaves positions untouched.
Return sub_4DCA80's result from each path.
